description: Day-by-day available inventory over a date range — for one item (item_ids with a single id), several items, or a whole category. Use it to answer 'which days next month still have space?'. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item/{item_id}/cal or GET /api/3.0/item/cal.

category_id.description: Instead of item ids, a category of items.

end_date.description: Range end date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

item_ids.description: Item ids. One id queries that item's calendar; several query them together.

start_date.description: Range start date — YYYYMMDD, YYYY-MM-DD, or a relative date such as "today".

name: checkfront_get_availability_calendar
title: Get an availability calendar
